mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for new home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for new home construction varies based on factors like home size, complexity, permits, and weather conditions. Generally, a custom home can take anywhere from 8 to 18 months from groundbreaking to move-in. This includes phases such as site preparation, foundation, framing, utilities, interior finishes, and final inspections. Delays can occur due to material availability or unexpected site challenges. A detailed schedule will be provided after the initial design and planning stages are complete.
